archive_sha256_note: measured: re-packaging the same tree gives the same archive sha256 (glow-po-reporting 0cf6073e... twice); packaging a fresh copy of it (cp -r, as execute.1.then builds $PKG in a new session) gives another sha256 with the same freeze digest, because skill-creator stores file mtimes. So the archives reviewed at X4.4 are the ones delivered, and a re-cut needs its own review round (P-100)
